hook_line: SPEECH TO TEXT IN 22 INDIAN LANGUAGES

hook_stat.sub: Per minute of audio — recognition and editing in a single API call

stats.label: Fewer character edits than Google's Gemini in Sarvam's own English tests
Custom names and terms accepted with each request

diaspora_bullets: Returns the text the speaker meant to write, not a literal transcript
Handles switching between English and an Indian language mid-sentence
news_summary: Bengaluru startup Sarvam AI has launched Sarvam Dictate, an API that turns speech into edited, ready-to-send text in English and 22 Indian languages.
payoff: India's voice AI market is projected to reach $1.8 billion by 2030.
